title: phibble
tagline: A typed, immutable data frame for PHP, with readr-style input and output.
summary: Load, transform, and summarize typed data frames in PHP. Tables are immutable, and `null` represents missing data.
Names and semantics follow R's tibble, readr, and dplyr. The same verbs run in memory, in SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, or in Polars.

example.chain:
use function Phibble\Expr\{col, desc, mean, n, sum};

$orders = \Phibble\DataFrame::fromCsv('orders.csv', types: [
    'channel' => 'factor',
    'coupon' => 'bool',
    'returned' => 'bool',
]);

echo $orders
    ->filter(col('returned')->not())
    ->mutate(['item_price' => col('total')->div(col('items'))])
    ->groupBy(['channel'])
    ->summarize([
        'orders' => n(),
        'revenue' => sum(col('total')),
        'item_price' => mean(col('item_price')),
        'coupons' => mean(col('coupon')),
    ], groups: 'drop')
    ->arrange([desc(col('revenue'))]);

evidence_gaps.benchmarks: No benchmark covers SqlTable on PostgreSQL or MySQL, or any run on macOS or Windows.
evidence_gaps.verification: The SQL checks run on PostgreSQL 17 and MySQL 8.0 only, so MariaDB and other server versions are unchecked, and no check runs on Windows.
